record.original_question: Prove or disprove that the non-analytic growth bound ζ(T ) of a C0 -semigroup T coincides with the critical growth bound ωcrit (T ).

evidence.quote: Problem 13 (Growth bounds). Prove or disprove that the non-analytic growth bound ζ(T ) of a C0 -semigroup T coincides with the critical growth bound ωcrit (T ).

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $X$ be a Banach space and let $T=(T(t))_{t\ge 0}$ be a $C_0$-semigroup of bounded linear operators on $X$ with generator $A$.

Recall the following growth bounds associated with $T$:

1. The exponential growth bound $\omega_0(T) = \inf\{\omega\in\mathbb{R} : \exists M\ge 1,\ \|T(t)\|\le M e^{\omega t}\ \forall t\ge 0\}$.

2. The non-analytic growth bound $\zeta(T)$, defined as the infimum of all $\omega\in\mathbb{R}$ such that there exist $\tau>0$ and a function $g:\{\lambda\in\mathbb{C}:\operatorname{Re}\lambda>\omega\}\to\mathcal{B}(X)$, holomorphic and bounded on every half-plane $\{\operatorname{Re}\lambda>\omega'\}$ with $\omega'>\omega$, satisfying
$$\sup_{t\ge 0} e^{-\omega t}\bigl\|T(t)x - \tfrac{1}{2\pi i}\int_{\sigma-i\infty}^{\sigma+i\infty} e^{\lambda t} g(\lambda)x\,d\lambda\bigr\| < \infty$$
for all $\sigma>\omega$ and all $x\in X$ (equivalently, the infimum of $\omega$ for which $T$ admits, modulo an exponentially bounded perturbation of rate $\omega$, a holomorphic extension of its Laplace transform to a half-plane).

3. The critical growth bound $\omega_{\mathrm{crit}}(T)$, defined by
$$\omega_{\mathrm{crit}}(T) = \inf\Bigl\{\omega\in\mathbb{R} : \limsup_{|s|\to\infty} \|(\lambda - A)^{-1}\| < \infty \text{ uniformly for } \operatorname{Re}\lambda \ge \omega'\ \text{for some}\ \omega'<\omega\Bigr\},$$
i.e.\ the infimum of those $\omega$ for which the resolvent of $A$ is uniformly bounded on the strip $\{\omega'\le \operatorname{Re}\lambda\}$ outside a compact set, for some $\omega'<\omega$.

Prove or disprove the following: for every $C_0$-semigroup $T$ on every Banach space $X$, one has
$$\zeta(T) = \omega_{\mathrm{crit}}(T).$$
artifact.status_search_result: The question of whether the non-analytic growth bound $\zeta(T)$ coincides with the critical growth bound $\omega_{\mathrm{crit}}(T)$ for $C_0$-semigroups appears in recent problem lists and survey works on semigroup growth bounds. Existing literature (Blake; Batty–Srivastava; Batty et al. on delay semigroups) establishes inequalities between these bounds and their relations to spectral quantities, but no general proof of equality nor a counterexample appears in the available sources, so the problem appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: The non-analytic growth bound of a C0-semigroup and inhomogeneous Cauchy problems
status_evidence.snippet: Defines the non-analytic growth bound ζ(T) of a C0-semigroup and relates it to spectral and resolvent conditions on the generator.
status_evidence.claim: Foundational definition of ζ(T) and its relation to other growth bounds; equality with the critical growth bound is not established in general.

status_evidence.title: Semigroup growth bounds (arXiv:math/0302144)
status_evidence.snippet: Survey-style discussion of various growth bounds including ζ(T) and ωcrit(T) for C0-semigroups.
status_evidence.claim: Discusses the hierarchy of growth bounds without proving the equality ζ(T)=ωcrit(T) in general.

status_evidence.title: Non-analytic growth bounds and delay semigroups
status_evidence.snippet: Studies ζ(T) for delay semigroups, computing it in special situations.
status_evidence.claim: Provides partial results in special cases but does not resolve the general equality.
